### 1.2 Seed Management

```python
# src/utils/seed.py — must cover ALL sources of randomness
def set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
```

## Retry & Rollback Policy

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Phase validation checkpoint fails | Fix before proceeding to next phase |
| M1 not achieved after 3 iterations | `/debug-gap` on baseline only — do NOT touch method code |
| M2 gap > 20% after 5 iterations | Re-verify M1; may be data/training issue not method issue |
| Execution crash after 3 retries | Mark `execution_failed` in LOOP_STATE.md, stop |
| Plateau detected | Run `/check-plateau` for type-specific escalation |

---

## Implementation Order Rationale

The order above is strict — later phases depend on earlier ones:

1. **Config first**: every other module reads config
2. **Data before model**: verify data shapes before building model to match them
3. **Baseline before method**: M1 must pass before M2 is attempted — loop contract enforces this
4. **Eval framework last**: requires model + data both working to produce meaningful output
